mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate a severe demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by > 5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contractions (INDPRO below 12-month moving average), corporate output and profits fall, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals emergency monetary easing, which triggers short-term positive equity market reactions over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high unemployment rate (above 7.5%) reflects weak labor market conditions, suppressing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 450.0 thousand units indicate a collapsing housing market, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 450.0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deepening economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises.
